Apple One bundle subscription vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Apple One subscription availability covers storefront language. Bundle subscription behavior and App Store Connect actually separate buyer subscription management from product-page copy:

  • Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions → Apple One — the system screen where buyers choose Individual, Family, or Premier tiers and subscribe to the multi-service bundle. Runtime Apple One entitlement and included-service access do not generate Chinese App Store listing text.
  • Individual, Family, and Premier tier cards — plan comparison UI showing which services each tier includes. Individual bundles Music, TV+, Arcade, and iCloud+. Family adds family sharing. Premier adds News+ and Fitness+. Listing copy describes tier value; configuring Apple One contracts is business operations, not Connect metadata.
  • Included-service icon rows — Music, TV+, Arcade, iCloud+, News+, Fitness+ logos on bundle marketing frames. Listing copy names the bundle composition; each included service has its own dedicated shop guide when that service is your lead story.
  • Bundle savings marketing — "Save with Apple One" or price-comparison callouts versus subscribing to each service separately. Description and caption fields explain bundle value; managing buyer Apple subscriptions is outside AppLocale.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Apple One being subscribed on their iPhone.

Apple One bundle subscription on buyer devices and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Apple One multi-service bundle value and 苹果 One / 一价全包订阅 placement on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you configure StoreKit subscription groups or bundle entitlements in code.

Does Apple One subscription auto-translate my China listing?

No. Apple One is a multi-service subscription bundle — it does not fill App Store Connect localization rows. If zh-Hans fields are empty, the China product page falls back to en-US copy even when your app markets 苹果 One or 一价全包订阅 on the US gallery.

Why do my Apple One screenshot captions still say Apple One in English?

Screenshot overlay lines are per localization. English Apple One tier cards on the en-US gallery do not propagate to zh-Hans until you paste Chinese caption text into the Chinese screenshot set.

What do I send after AppLocale payment?

Your live App Store listing URL, current English listing fields, Apple One–related screenshot overlay lines, target locale (zh-Hans), and any frame counts. Reply from the email address on your Stripe receipt — we deliver to that Stripe email within 24 hours.

How is Apple One different from Apple Arcade, iCloud+, or Apple Music?

Apple One marketing covers the multi-service subscription bundle — Individual, Family, and Premier tiers combining Music, TV+, Arcade, iCloud+, News+, and Fitness+. Apple Arcade marketing covers games catalog placement alone — 苹果街机. iCloud+ marketing covers storage plans alone — 储存空间计划. Apple Music marketing covers music streaming alone. Apple One is the bundle picker; each included service has its own listing scope when that service leads your gallery.

How is this different from the Apple TV app, Apple News, and Fitness listing pages?

Apple TV app marketing covers the streaming catalog app — TV+ shows and channels. Apple News marketing covers News+ publications. Apple Fitness marketing covers workout sessions and Activity rings — 健身. This page covers Apple One tier comparison cards and bundle composition on your product page — even when your app leverages services included in the Apple One bundle.

We do not guarantee keyword position or download growth. Complete zh-Hans metadata helps bundle-curious buyers who already found your page understand Apple One multi-service value in their language.
